faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity (MOQ) is 1,000 pcs. Custom printed packaging quotes and production runs start at 1,000 units.

faqs.q: Can I order custom cosmetic boxes sized to my specific container?
faqs.a: Yes. Every cosmetic box is custom-manufactured to your exact bottle, jar, dropper, or tube dimensions plus necessary clearance so your container fits securely without rattling.

faqs.q: What finishes are available for cosmetic packaging?
faqs.a: We offer soft-touch matte lamination, high-gloss lamination, metallic hot foil stamping (gold, silver, rose gold), blind embossing and debossing, and spot UV varnishing.

faqs.q: Do you provide dieline templates for our artwork designer?
faqs.a: Yes. Once we know your product dimensions and chosen box structure, we generate an exact vector dieline PDF showing cut lines, fold lines, and bleed margins for your artwork.

faqs.q: What box structures work best for cosmetic bottles and jars?
faqs.a: Straight tuck, reverse tuck, and auto-lock bottom cartons are common for cosmetic bottles and jars. Heavier glass fills often need a reinforced base and a paperboard cradle or neck collar.

faqs.q: Can cosmetic boxes include inserts for fragile glass?
faqs.a: Yes. Custom paperboard inserts, trays, and collars hold droppers, jars, and tubes in place so products stay presentation-ready through shipping and shelf handling.

faqs.q: Are small-order and wholesale cosmetic runs both available?
faqs.a: Yes. Box Studio supports both smaller brand launches and larger wholesale replenishment. Share your quantity range in the quote so we can recommend a practical production path.

faqs.q: Can one cosmetic packaging family share the same look across SKUs?
faqs.a: Yes. Brands often keep a shared colour story, finish, and typography across cartons while changing only the dieline size and product-facing panel copy for each SKU.

faqs.q: How do I request a quote for custom boxes?
faqs.a: Open the product or category page that matches your fill, then submit a quote with internal dimensions, quantity intent, preferred finishes, and artwork notes. Box Studio confirms structure and pricing from that brief.

faqs.q: What information do you need to size my packaging correctly?
faqs.a: Share the closed product length, width, and height (or bottle diameter and fill height), plus any insert needs. We add clearance so the product fits securely without rattling or crushing.

faqs.q: Can I print my logo and brand colors on the boxes?
faqs.a: Yes. Custom printed packaging supports CMYK brand colors, logos, and panel hierarchy. Soft-touch, gloss, foil, emboss, and spot UV can be added once the structure is confirmed.

faqs.q: Do folding cartons ship flat?
faqs.a: Yes. Most folding carton styles ship flat for efficient storage and freight, then erect quickly for packing. Rigid gift formats that stay set up are called out separately when needed.

faqs.q: Can I order a sample or dieline before production?
faqs.a: Yes. After dimensions and structure are agreed, we can provide a dieline for artwork and discuss sampling options so you can check fit and print before a full run.
